main_text.p: quibus aliquis ex noftra familia ante aliquot centum annos, in Senatu patriæ(vt certo animaduertimus) ad confirmandum confilium quoddam publicum, quod ad-huc referuatur, vfus fuit. Nec intermittere hoc loco poffum, quid de nobis Morauiæ fcribat Hiftoricus. Ille enim multis probare conatur rationibus, familiam Zaftri-fellorum ex Galliis oriundam. Quicquid fit, grata nobis effe debet ifta cum Gallis amicitia, inprimis D. Bezæ viri nobilissimi erga nos omnes beneuolentia fingularis. Viuat igitur Beza cum fuis omnibus, viuat iterum atque iterum, cui placidam optamus fenectam, cui officia noftra deferimus omnia. Scripsi ex arce Bofcovicenfi, Menfe Martio. cIↄ. Iↄ. xcvii.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is present in the lower part of the scan and was left out. The year is printed in the old reversed-C form: cIↄ. Iↄ. xcvii, rendered as MDXCVII. The text as printed reads "cIↄ. Iↄ. xcvii"; the numeral is given as printed.
